verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your love's making all things new
You're working in all for good

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
For the things of this world
There is hope renewed
In the life that is found in You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You make all things new
You make all things new

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Yesterday and forever
Your love never changing

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
My faith is in things unseen
Bringing life where it has not been

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Speaking things that are not
As if they were
I am alive in You

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:

I know that I am chosen

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I am alive in You
I am alive in You

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
God You are restoring
All things for Your glory

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines:
I am alive in You
I am alive in You
